item.title: Possible Salvation for At-Risk Kenmore Presbyterian Church Structure?
item.description: There’s good news on the Kenmore Presbyterian Church preservation front. When the owners – a Rochester-based group – proposed demolishing the architecturally significant structure to make way for a Shake Shack, the preservation community was aghast. The intent-to-demolish immediately caught the attention of Preservation Buffalo Niagara (PBN), which soon-after went to work on coming up with a tactic to rescue the former church. item.description: Erie County Parks, Recreation & Forestry has rolled out its Commemorative Tree Program, where people can memorialize a loved one by purchasing a tree, to be planted in their name. item.title: Celebrating Women’s History Month in Erie County
item.description: Author: Deputy County Executive Lisa Chimera March 1 marks the start of Women’s History Month, a time during which our nation honors the accomplishments and historical contributions of women, while drawing attention to the challenges they still face. President Jimmy Carter was the first to issue a Presidential Proclamation declaring the Week of March 8, 1980 as National Women’s History Week.
